messages:
Marta - CS: FYI Asterion Health (acct AHE-904) is seeing intermittent 429s during an EU pilot demo. They requested a 48h buffer around launch. Need header-based routing to eu-west + per-key QPS bump. Proposed: per_key_qps=600, burst=1200, window=60s. Anyone available to change routing and lift QPS?

James - CS: Is this prod? Any static IPs to allowlist?

Marta - CS: Yes prod. They're behind CloudFront so IPs are dynamic. Token est ~300k tokens/hr, peaks ~1.2k req/min. Customer rep is onboarding@asterion.health — they agree to header routing.

Janet - Ops: I can stage a customer routing override (route_by_header) and raise rate limits. Need infra signoff for burst pool allocation. Will post the patch preview before applying.

Ryan - Infra: We can accommodate 600 qps per key in eu-west for 48h by moving to the burst pool (+8 GPU slots equivalent). Risk: other tenants could see degraded burst capacity at peak. Recommend gating via header X-Customer-ID == AHE-904.

Marta - CS: Customer accepted header gating. No CIDRs provided. Proceed with header-gated route + 48h qps bump.

Janet - Ops: Patch preview:
```json
{
  "account_id": "AHE-904",
  "routing_override": "eu-west",
  "route_by_header": "X-Customer-ID",
  "rate_limit": { "per_key_qps": 600, "burst": 1200, "window_seconds": 60 },
  "duration": "48h"
}
```

Janet - Ops: Applying to prod now.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-21T15:43Z - change_id: change-AHE904-20260321-01 - applied by Janet - Ops

Janet - Ops: Change applied. Monitoring hooks added to AHE-904 dashboard.

James - CS: Added AHE-904 to watchlist. Set alerts: error_rate > 0.8% OR p95_latency > 600ms -> rollback.

Ryan - Infra: I'll monitor eu-west pool utilization and can revert or throttle if other customers hit burst shortages.

Marta - CS: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and keep the incident thread open for 48h. :tada:

James - CS: :thumbsup:
